subject: [PATCH v5 21/22] iomap: pass iomap_iter_next_fn directly instead of struct iomap_ops

2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch simplifies the iomap code by removing the struct iomap_ops and passing the iomap_iter_next_fn directly to various functions. This change is possible because all filesystems have implemented ->iomap_next() and no longer use the legacy ->iomap_begin()/->iomap_end() fallback. The patch also renames the 'ops' field in the iomap_iter tracepoint to 'next'. No functional changes are intended, only a simplification of the code.
